name: Rush 2 Recompiled
description: Native PS5 homebrew port of Rush 2 Recompiled, based on the recompiled Nintendo 64 version of Rush 2: Extreme Racing USA. Uses RT64 with Vulkan through RADV, outputs at 4K and runs at 60 FPS using frame interpolation. Supports DualSense controls and audio. Requires your own legally obtained Rush 2: Extreme Racing USA ROM in Z64, N64 or V64 format; no ROM or original game data is included.
author: Marice
